item.title: Meta's ships facial recognition on smart glasses
item.description:
📝 SFace Sigmoid-Constrained Hypersphere Loss for Face Recognition (Zhong et al. A cosine-similarity face index, dimensioned exactly to the on-device fingerprinterThe recognition pipeline that actually runs and reads into this database:/data/user/0/com. Recognition is a cosine-similarity query against that index, followed by a join into person.
